description: Generates real, working code with real, live verification — not just an LLM's opinion. Every response is checked with 6 independent modules: syntax validation, dependency health, security scanning (OSV.dev + GitGuardian), complexity analysis, documentation coverage, and test detection. Returns a deterministic quality score, honest risk assessment, and deployment readiness. SPENDS your balance — requires FD_API_KEY.

max_wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to poll (default 60, agent typically takes up to 55s given generation plus 6-module verification). On timeout, returns task_id to poll later.

task_description.description: What code to generate, e.g. "Write a Python function to validate an email address, with tests."

name: forcedream_generate_code
title: Generate verified code
